viewing_check: Look for the Mabef stamp or brand burn on the mast or base and the model number; check the crank or mast mechanism works and locks, the tilt works, the castors and floor lock screws are present, and the drawer and tray are intact (blue tape). Measure height (large models are about 2 m+).
